import numpy as np

# Compare L0H0 attention patterns across runs to decide AGGREGATOR vs ROUTER
# Key distinction: AGGREGATOR spreads uniformly, ROUTER concentrates on ONE position

data_r2 = np.load("/work/fwd/r2/run.npz")
data_r8 = np.load("/work/fwd/r8/run.npz")

pattern_r2 = data_r2['L0H0_ATTN_pattern']  # [4, 10, 10]
pattern_r8 = data_r8['L0H0_ATTN_pattern']  # [5, 10, 10]

print("=== L0H0 AGGREGATOR vs ROUTER test ===")
print("If AGGREGATOR: attention spreads across many positions (~1/9 each for uniform)")
print("If ROUTER: attention concentrates on ONE specific position\n")

# For uniform input (all 5s), all positions should be treated symmetrically
# AGGREGATOR would give ~1/9 = 0.111 to each non-BOS position
# r2 input 2 is all 5s
print("Uniform input (all 5s) - attention spread at pos 1:")
attn_uniform = pattern_r2[2, 1, :]
print(f"  Attention values: {attn_uniform.round(3)}")
print(f"  Max: {attn_uniform.max():.3f}, Min: {attn_uniform.min():.3f}")
print(f"  Entropy (bits): {-np.sum(attn_uniform * np.log2(attn_uniform + 1e-10)):.3f}")
print(f"  Max entropy for 10 positions: {np.log2(10):.3f}")

# Check if attention shifts when the unique high-value token moves
print("\n=== Does L0H0 at pos 2 (tok=0) attend to the pos with tok=5? ===")
# In r8: 
#   input 0: tok=5 at pos 1
#   input 1: tok=5 at pos 6
#   input 2: tok=5 at pos 9
print("Attention from pos 2 to position with tok=5:")
print(f"  5 at pos 1: attn[2,1] = {pattern_r8[0, 2, 1]:.4f} (vs all-0s: {pattern_r8[4, 2, 1]:.4f})")
print(f"  5 at pos 6: attn[2,6] = {pattern_r8[1, 2, 6]:.4f} (vs all-0s: {pattern_r8[4, 2, 6]:.4f})")
print(f"  5 at pos 9: attn[2,9] = {pattern_r8[2, 2, 9]:.4f} (vs all-0s: {pattern_r8[4, 2, 9]:.4f})")
print("If ROUTER: should have HIGH attention to the tok=5 position")
print("If AGGREGATOR: should have roughly equal attention everywhere")
